status: Native Adaptive Wide Angle implemented and107 focused Debug tests pass. Full F05 and Photoshop parity remain open; broad qualification is batched with Vanishing Point.
scope: Native camera-ray straightening with line/polygon constraints, per-edge orientations, Auto/Fisheye/Perspective/Panorama/Full Spherical, focal/crop/scale, native workspace/preview/history/settings, editable Smart Filters/native31 and shared API/Actions/Batch.

primary_references.scope: Correction projections, scale/focal/crop controls, line/polygon constraints and edge orientations. As Shot and manufacturer/Photomerge metadata matching are not implemented.

primary_references.finding: No dedicated Adaptive Wide Angle operation. Unqualified adaptiveWideAngle actionJSON rejects explicitly.

implementation_choices: Native Swift camera rays and great-circle interpolation feed a sparse similarity mesh and existing WarpRaster triangle renderer. Input remains fixed extent with transparent uncovered pixels.
Panorama uses an explicit cylindrical mapping; it is not a Perspective alias and is not claimed equivalent to Adobe Photomerge calibration.

Free edge normals start from the source chord, unlike the upstream first horizontal iteration. Grid cells have an8-pixel minimum on small images; upper grid density follows the source48-long-side-cell design.
Two-entry settings/size geometry cache prevents repeated mesh solves for preview admission, composition and overlay. No cached pixels or user defaults. Cancelled solves never enter it.
Shared FilterDraft input geometry resolves Smart Object placement and the preceding filter prefix. Pointer coordinates freeze the inverse mesh for a drag. Lens Correction now reuses the same helper.

photato_api.state: Strict settings/schema/defaults plus active workspace settings, tool, preview/rendering, overlays, zoom, selected constraint/segment, pending polygon count, resolved model and local history availability. Existing command routes share the native engine and transactions.

adobe_api.scope: No new Adobe route. Unqualified adaptiveWideAngle actionJSON and editable PSD/PSB descriptors reject. Existing rendered raster output remains available.

qualification: 107 focused Debug tests pass on current source. Optimized/full regression and universal packaging are batched at the F05 family milestone; the last packaged candidate remains step185 and excludes Lens Correction and Adaptive Wide Angle.

tests.independent_evidence: Source480×320 fisheye straightness/locality constraints; analytical camera/cylindrical rays; identity/scale/transparent border tests. All-depth selections/locks/history, validation, native31/source preservation/filter masking, transformed Smart Objects/prefix coordinates, native controller/Cancel/local undo, HTTP/busy/stale/invalid and Actions/Batch agreement. These are not Photoshop output or live UI evidence.
tests.offscreen_limit: Preview and constraint overlay/control layout inspected. Native AppKit buttons/pickers are incompletely captured offscreen. Live pointer/keyboard and exact visual matching remain unqualified.
tests.performance: Source480×320 constrained solve about23s in Debug; no optimized performance claim. Subsequent matching preview/composition geometry reuses the bounded cache.

limitations: Exact Adobe output, resampling/colour/edge semantics, live controls and physical macOS14/26/Intel qualification remain open. Latest desktop evidence remains locked, without bypass/re-probe.
No camera/lens manufacturer database, automatic EXIF As Shot, Adobe settings interchange or calibrated Photomerge panorama matching. Auto is a documented heuristic, not profile matching.

Current8,388,608-input-pixel limit,64 constraints/128 total segments/32 points per constraint. Unsupported antipodal or horizon-crossing arcs reject instead of silently changing projection. Larger image performance remains open.
RGB8/16 use encoded samples; RGB32 uses linear pixels as a native extension. Full Photoshop document colour-mode/filter matrix is not implemented.

Fixed canvas extent can crop corrected geometry. Complex later geometry filters, folded meshes and all interactive edge cases remain unqualified. Mesh constraints use bilinear interpolation while rasterization triangulates cells.
Editable PSD/PSB and Adobe descriptors remain unsupported. Native31 preserves settings/source editability; raster exports remain available.
Magnifier/detail panel, complete constraint keyboard/context interactions, Photoshop preset interoperability and exact workspace styling remain outstanding refinements.

Optimized/full regression/universal packaging is batched at the F05 milestone. Step185 is the last universal candidate; Lens Correction and Adaptive Wide Angle are currently source/Debug changes. Full F05 remains open.
next: Vanishing Point: native perspective plane creation and editing, perspective paste/clone/painting with preview/history/persistence/API; then batched F05 full/optimized/universal qualification.

later_family_qualification.note: Later family batch includes Lens Correction, Adaptive Wide Angle and Vanishing Point. Earlier milestone records remain historical. Exact/live/platform parity remains open.
